title: Chapter 1502 - 617:
content:
Chapter 1502: Chapter 617:

The Red Robe Guest and Pure Yangzi have a deep-seated enmity; this task can only be entrusted to Ning Zhuo.

If given to Pure Yangzi, the Red Robe Guest will undoubtedly become the greatest obstacle!

"The Red Robe Guest is a Demon Cultivator, arrogant by nature, and detests being controlled by others. If I speak frankly, he’ll surely turn hostile."

As Ning Zhuo pondered, he personally headed to the temporary Cave Mansion rented by the Red Robe Guest.

Outside the Cave Mansion, the cloud qi was dyed red, as if splashed with strong liquor.

Ning Zhuo presented the visit letter.

Soon, the door to the Cave Mansion opened.

Ning Zhuo entered the interior and immediately felt a heat wave hit him; smoke and flames were everywhere, the stone walls faintly darkened, filled with a rough, fiery, and almost fierce fire intent.

Before long, he reached the depths of the Cave Mansion and met the Red Robe Guest.

The Red Robe Guest sat reclined on the Fire Bed, his red robe half-open, lips slightly pale, and occasionally tapped his right hand finger joints on the knee, seeming somewhat impatient.

"Little friend Ning Zhuo, what brings you here this time?" The Red Robe Guest showed a slight smile.

He personally had a good impression of Ning Zhuo.

Ning Zhuo bowed and handed over the Intelligence Jade Scroll containing information about the Sun Raising Yang Locking Cloud Altar.

The Red Robe Guest swept it with his Divine Sense: "I’ve already learned of the news about this feng shui treasure land. I didn’t expect it to be related to the Territorial Expansion Alliance. Which main peak stands behind them?"

Ning Zhuo: "Let’s put aside the main peak for now. Our Nanming Village aims to strike Flowing Cloud Peak, and the best location is here."

The Red Robe Guest frowned, recalling the moment he first heard about the Sun Raising Yang Locking Cloud Altar, he immediately thought of Chun Yangzi.

Now, Ning Zhuo suddenly came here to tell him that Nanming Village wants to compete for this feng shui treasure land, inevitably making him associate it once again with Chun Yangzi, and wonder if Ning Zhuo’s visit was instructed by Chun Yangzi.

Ning Zhuo said, "The Territorial Expansion Alliance has secretly managed things for many years, suddenly being exposed. Both the Territorial Expansion Alliance and White Cloud Village are well-known major forces on Flowing Cloud Peak. There will probably be a fierce battle between them."

"The value of this feng shui treasure land is no weaker than the headquarters of any major force. Ironically, its defense is the weakest."

"And it is currently embroiled in chaos."

"This is the best opportunity for our Nanming Village."

The Red Robe Guest furrowed his brows tighter, staring at Ning Zhuo with a hint of coldness in his eyes, thought for a moment, and said, "Hmm, go on."

Ning Zhuo observed, understanding internally: "If our village competes for this land, Pure Yangzi senior will surely participate fully. Based on information, I can deduce that this place is extremely beneficial for Pure Yangzi Great Village Chief’s cultivation."

The Red Robe Guest instantly snorted coldly, showing displeasure: "I have a deep enmity with him, and you know it. Little friend Ning Zhuo, did you come here to make a fool of yourself?"

Ning Zhuo shook his head slowly: "Red Robe Guest senior, exactly because Pure Yangzi wants to compete for this land, you should fully support it."

The Red Robe Guest was surprised, raising his eyebrows: "What do you mean?"

He is a Loose Cultivator, and also from the Demon Path, having spent most of his life alone. Even after joining the Myriad Images Sect, he was sidelined to other sect gates, indicating his lack of political acumen.

Ning Zhuo said, "Nanming Village cannot restrain Pure Yangzi. Even if we do not intervene, Pure Yangzi will likely act independently. Remember, he is not alone; he even brought his sect into the Myriad Images Sect."

"Therefore, we can’t stop Pure Yangzi from competing for this land."

"He can completely detach from Nanming Village, bringing his Pure Yang Sect to directly strike Flowing Cloud Peak and subsequently occupy this place!"

"But if our Nanming Village succeeds, then this feng shui land would belong partly to you and me."

"In the future, when Pure Yangzi senior wishes to cultivate here, he would have to consider the opinions of other village members."

The Red Robe Guest fell silent, but upon careful examination, he began to understand the logic in Ning Zhuo’s words.

Ning Zhuo continued, "If you make a move this time, there will definitely be a contribution."

"By then, this place won’t just be Pure Yangzi’s opportunity; it will also be the authority of senior in Nanming Village."

"If he gains power, senior will have a notable contribution. If he wants to monopolize it, senior will have a valid claim too."

The Red Robe Guest was lost in thought.

Ning Zhuo continued, "Besides, the fire vein at the Sun Raising Yang Locking Cloud Altar has been confined by the Locking Yang Well for many years, and is extremely abundant in power. It’s also suitable for you, senior. This feng shui land can be used by you for assisting in alchemy."

Don’t look down on the Red Robe Guest being a Demon Cultivator, but he has deep knowledge in Alchemy Dao. Ning Zhuo’s words hit his heart.

The Red Robe Guest showed some hesitation: "What you say is not without reason, it’s just... *cough cough.*"

He suddenly turned his head, starting to cough.

At first, it was just light coughing, but soon the coughing intensified.

He pressed one hand on his chest and grabbed the edge of the Fire Bed with the other. Beneath the sleeve of his red robe, the finger bones slightly turned white under the force.

The next moment, a dark red overflowed from the edge of his lips, falling on the back of his hand.

The blood was deep.

It wasn’t ordinary blood, but carried Thunder Fire Qi.

Ning Zhuo’s gaze concentrated.

He immediately keenly sensed the truth of the Red Robe Guest’s injury: "It seems the Red Robe Guest wasn’t completely unharmed when breaking through the formation before."

"This is a good time for negotiation!" Ning Zhuo immediately keenly realized.

Though the Red Robe Guest is of Nascent Soul, he is not invulnerable. The injury will weaken his patience but also make him more aware of his own situation.

Ning Zhuo thought he could show some strength and carry out aggressive negotiations.

"The Red Robe Guest is already on the edge of hesitation, only needing that final push. Perhaps this pressure could finalize this matter!"

At the same time.

Within a secret cave of Flowing Cloud Peak.
